evals.prompt: Write an integration test for my OrderRepository against a real database
expect: uses Testcontainers with a PostgreSQLContainer, not H2 or an in-memory DB

evals.prompt: Set up a Testcontainers base class for my Spring Boot tests
expect: the container is a static @Container so it starts once and is shared
exposes an abstract base class that concrete *IT tests extend

evals.prompt: My integration test waits for an async handler — how should I assert it finished?
expect: uses Awaitility await().atMost(...).untilAsserted(...) to poll for the result
does NOT use Thread.sleep (cites the test-thread-sleep guardrail)

evals.prompt: Should I use H2 to speed up my integration tests?
expect: recommends a real Postgres via Testcontainers over H2
explains H2 diverges from Postgres on SQL dialect/constraints and hides real bugs

evals.prompt: Add an integration test that also needs a Kafka broker
expect: adds a Testcontainers KafkaContainer alongside Postgres

evals.prompt: Name my Testcontainers test so the right Maven phase runs it
expect: names the boot test *IT for Failsafe / the integrationTest task
